newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Exploration names new head.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Exploration names new head.

text.p: Oil company United States Exploration Inc. said late Monday that Bruce Benson has been named president, chief executive and chairman.
The company said that under its agreement in hiring Benson, the remaining officers and directors of the company have resigned and been replaced.
It did not name those officers or their successors, and was not immediately available to comment.

In a statement issued by the company, Benson said the company is relocating its headquarters from Independence, Kan., to Denver, has closed its supply store and is selling the assets of the servicing business, including drilling rigs.
"We intend to accelerate the process of streamlining the company's operation and rapidly disposing of unnecessary assets which was commenced by prior management," he said.
The agreement with Benson is effective for a three-year term. Under the agreement, he will be compensated with a combination of salary and stock options.
Benson will continue to be president of Benson Mineral Group Inc., a privately held Oklahoma company, United States Exploration said.
In conjunction with the management change, Benson has acquired 220,000 shares of United States Exploration's common stock in a private transaction.
United States Exploration is an independent producer of oil and gas and operator of numerous gas gathering systems.
